topic: Mall traffic data discrepancies and model updates
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies in mall total traffic data following a model migration and update. Initial concerns noted that the overall traffic totals for the mall did not correlate with unique user counts (uniques) after October 20th, suggesting an issue with how the system was calculating or aggregating data.

It was determined that historical data prior to the model change (before Oct 20th) had been processed using an outdated script, which contributed to the current discrepancies. The unique user counts were found to be lower than expected, particularly for UK data.

A plan was established to reaggregate the data historically and test the results on a staging environment before updating production. It was also discussed adding a factor to the sample calculation, but this was tabled pending further review.
decisions: The historical dataset needs to be reaggregated to correct discrepancies in total traffic totals.
Testing of the corrected data must first occur on the staging environment (STAGE) before updating production (PROD).
action_items: Someone will provide a user for UK data analysis.
The team needs to compare Total Traffic (Mall) against client-provided data.
